page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.2-16 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on AMD EPYC 9J45 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 2 physical cores mapped to 4 dedicated vCPUs with simultaneous multithreading enabled at two threads per core. System memory totals 16.0 GB RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

The instance operates without integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistent data retention and operating system hosting. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address for external network access. There are no discrete GPU accelerators attached, positioning the server strictly for conventional central processing tasks rather than hardware-accelerated matrix computation or model training.

Offering dedicated CPU allocation and standard memory proportions, this flex shape provides consistent resource availability without shared-core throttling. The 4 vCPU and 16 GB memory footprint makes it suitable for horizontal microservices, application backends, container orchestration nodes, intermediate web servers, build workers, and small-to-midsize relational or non-relational database nodes.
